scores.evidence: Each segment has its own visual anchor: the goal/feature definition list and the feature-to-goal table in 2-2, the MoSCoW table in 2-3, the 6-step procedure and the screen-flow diagram s2-b4 in 2-4, plus the prompt cards. The diagram labels are large, in the right language and readable at 390 px (pages/mobile-jp-14.png, pages/desktop-en-10.png).

Fresh metrics.json shows no text-only screens in any locale. Desktop JP lines run 37 chars (median, target 30–40) and EN lines 71 (target 60–75). The longer q8 options in check-quiz wrap to 2 even lines on mobile (pages/mobile-jp-19.png) and on desktop EN (pages/desktop-en-13.png). On desktop JP each one fits on a single line (pages/desktop-jp-13.png). The option cards keep their spacing, and the quiz does not turn into a wall of text.

The rewritten q8 options are fully localized. JP '画面名と保存する項目名だけを、自分で決めて書き足す' appears in pages/desktop-jp-13.png and pages/mobile-jp-19.png. EN 'Decide just the screen names and field names yourself, and add them' appears in pages/desktop-en-13.png. Neither locale mixes in the other language. Contrast is unchanged, and on mobile the last option sits above the bottom bar (pages/mobile-jp-19.png).

niceToHave: process: no shell was available in this round, so I could not run git diff or review-scope.mjs. The changed blocks were inferred from the other reviewers' must-fix items and the current draft: q8 options and explanation in check-quiz, the q4 explanation in s3-check, and the card-goal back in summary-cards. The changedShare of about 3/30 is an estimate. Confirm the list with review-scope.mjs before gating.

check-quiz q8 explanation, s3-check q4 explanation and the summary-cards card-goal back only show after the learner answers or flips a card, so the static captures do not show them (pages/desktop-jp-10.png, pages/desktop-jp-15.png, pages/mobile-jp-23.png show the unanswered or front states). Their length is similar to the previous text, so no layout risk is expected.

s2-b4: the two curved edges between the money-left screen and the input screen carry the labels '追加ボタン' and '保存' side by side. At 390 px it is hard to tell which label goes with which arrow (pages/mobile-jp-14.png). Consider labelling them '追加ボタンで→' and '保存で戻る', or describing the round trip in the caption.
reader: the flashcard hint reads 'クリックまたはスペースキーでめくる' on mobile (pages/mobile-jp-23.png). On touch devices it should say 'タップしてめくる'.

reader: on desktop, the sidebar outline marks sections the learner has only scrolled past as '未回答' / 'Unanswered' with an alert icon (pages/desktop-jp-13.png, pages/desktop-en-13.png). This may read as an error rather than a reminder.
reader: the mobile-jp capture is still marked truncated in metrics.json. The last screen (pages/mobile-jp-25.png) overlaps the previous one, but the content appears complete.
summary: This is a verification round, and the change is not structural. The previous visual-qa review had no must-fix items, so there was nothing to resolve. The fresh metrics.json is clean: no overflow, console, mermaid, unknown-block or image errors, no text-only screens, and line lengths on target. The changes are text edits from the other reviewers: q8 options and explanation in check-quiz, the q4 explanation in s3-check, and the card-goal back in summary-cards. The new q8 options render cleanly in JP desktop, JP mobile and EN desktop, with no clipping, overlap or untranslated text. I found no regressions and added no must-fix items.
